title: briza brasiliensis
intro: Briza brasiliensis, commonly known as Brazilian quaking grass, is a type of grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. This plant is known for its medicinal properties, which include its ability to reduce inflammation and improve respiratory health. The health benefits of Briza brasiliensis include its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects, which can help to protect against oxidative stress and cell damage. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties.
